shadcn_overrides.calendar: customize with dark theme, border-white/10, bg-[#0A0C22]

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set hover text/bg colors to maintain contrast.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for lists and bento grid items using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.effects: Use moving gradient 'tracing beam' for featured competition cards to signify active competitions.

hero_background.description: Elegant abstract fluid ink art in dark blue with shimmering gold accents. Used as the main background layer for the marketing hero section with a bg-[#050614]/60 overlay.

marketing_freelancer_1.description: Man working on a laptop at night, used in 'How it works' or features section.

marketing_freelancer_2.description: Woman typing on a laptop, used in the freelancer benefits section.

competition_texture.description: Sunlight reflecting on dark water. Used as a subtle texture for the client dashboard header.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='post-project-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Strictly follow the Dark Luxury archetype. Colors are Dark Blue, Purple, and Gold.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Use Gold (#D4AF37) for primary CTAs to signify competition and winning, avoid using purple for CTAs.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement 'Crystal Glass' for the header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050614]/70) ensuring text is legible.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: In marketing pages, use the Bento Grid pattern (Tetris Grid) with aggressive asymmetry.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: In the dashboard, use the Control Room Grid with tight gaps and flat backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for main headings to establish an editorial, high-end feel.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but strip their default borders and radii to match the sharp, luxurious theme (radius: 0px).
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Ensure 3:1 contrast ratio for interactive elements and 4.5:1 for standard text.
